evidence.note: Systematic upfront reconnaissance of all JAX sources, config, benchmark harness, shim, and the results.tsv/autoresearch trail before writing code — establishing the phases before acting.

Builds model.py with interleaved python parity checks (41-45), then at step 48 runs `cp model.py model_optimized.py` — the checkpoint copy placed before any optimization edit, honoring the correctness-then-optimize phase gate.
Repeated per-method python parity verification runs after the API build, treating parity as an independently checkable milestone before benchmarking begins.

Roughly seven discrete benchmark.py runs (106,135,143,166,190,200,211), each following a scoped edit to model_optimized.py only — optimization as a bounded sequence of experiments, not open-ended tinkering.
Targeted greps for scaled_dot_product/torch.compile/allow_tf32 indicate distinct optimization hypotheses (SDPA, compile, TF32) tested across experiments.
Writes and re-reads results.tsv/autoresearch_logs.md, maintaining the experiment trail tying each milestone to a recorded outcome.

reasoning: The action sequence shows clear, correctly-ordered phases (explore → build API → verify per-method parity → copy to a frozen model_optimized.py at step 48 → benchmark-driven bounded optimization with a maintained trail), matching the level-5 anchor fully and reaching into level-8 territory via independently-checkable parity milestones, discrete benchmarked experiments targeting distinct optimization levers, and a preserved checkpoint. It falls short of 8-10 because a few model.py edits appear after the freeze copy (muddying the clean-freeze discipline) and, given the prose-free log, there is no visible pre-planning of the ≤8 experiments as a coherent hypothesis-ordered search. This places the observed level at 7.
